issues.legal_issue: Proceeds received by a purchaser from crops already harvested by the seller constitute agricultural income of the purchaser.
material_facts: The assessee purchased crops that the vendor had already harvested and removed from the land.
The assessee later realised proceeds from those harvested crops.
The assessee had not raised those crops or performed agricultural operations in respect of them.
issues.conclusion: The proceeds from the already harvested crops were not agricultural income of the assessee and were not assessable as such. The appeal was dismissed. The Court did not decide the treatment of crops that were still standing when the estate was purchased.
issues.legal_principle: Under the Coorg Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1951, agricultural income must be derived by the assessee through agricultural operations, a process ordinarily employed by a cultivator to render produce fit for market, or the sale of produce raised or received by the assessee. Proceeds from crops harvested and removed by a vendor before their purchase are not derived by the purchaser in those ways. The judgment cites no particular section or earlier case.

rule.if: agricultural_income_tax_assessment and crops_harvested_before_purchase and buyer_resold_crops and no_buyer_agricultural_operations

predicates.agricultural_income_tax_assessment: The proceeding determines whether receipts are agricultural income liable to tax.
predicates.crops_harvested_before_purchase: The seller harvested and removed the crops before the purchaser acquired them.
predicates.buyer_resold_crops: The purchaser later realised proceeds by selling the crops acquired in harvested condition.
predicates.no_buyer_agricultural_operations: The purchaser did not raise the crops or perform agricultural operations or cultivator processes in respect of them.

issues.definition: When a tax assessment concerns agricultural income and the buyer resells crops harvested before purchase without performing agricultural operations on them, the proceeds are not agricultural income of the buyer.
